zh-CN.title: 欢迎消息成为一段真正的会话
items: 欢迎消息 Drawer 现在完整采用聊天会话的消息区与底部输入栏结构
保留表情、语音、相册和文件，移除不适用的位置与足迹地图入口

en.title: Welcome messages now behave like a real conversation
items: The welcome message drawer now uses the full chat conversation and composer structure
Emoji, voice, gallery, and files remain available without location or footprint map actions
